analyst_view.overall: Early view: Alex Pastoor's first match in charge of PEC Zwolle, appointed on 7 November, partly on a trial basis. Telstar are 16th but beat Utrecht 4-2 and came back from 2-0 down at Fortuna with two set-piece goals; one report says fans turned on coach Henk Brugge after their cup exit, so pressure is on both sides of this relegation-zone game.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.2 goals. I lean a little lower: PEC have scored only 13 in 12 games and a new coach usually starts by tightening the team, while a 16th v 13th game tends to be cagey. Telstar's set pieces are the main route to goals.

corners.text: The numbers say 10.1 corners. Telstar's set-piece threat makes corners valuable to them, and the home side should earn more of them, but nothing suggests a big change from the estimate.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.2 cards. I lean higher because this is a relegation six-pointer between two nervy sides, and Telstar's 1.1 home cards looks low for a team that needs the points as badly as they do.

shots.text: The numbers say 30.1 shots, 18.5 of them Telstar's. I lean lower: that is a big home figure for a team in 16th, and PEC under a new coach are likely to sit compact rather than open up.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.6 shots on target. With PEC's low scoring and a likely cautious first game under Pastoor, I expect fewer clean chances than the estimate.
